findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "A systems-minded approach to product work." → 3 lines (6 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "SaaS / Fintech" above "Bancassurance Platform"; "SaaS / Logistics / AI / In progress" above "WarehouseLens"; "Media Tech / Self-Hosted / In progress" above "Opsis"; "SaaS / Fintech" above "Steward"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "Nairobi, Kenya. Available worldwide.", "Profiles", "Currently building", "Location"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.
Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 24 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): nav.fixed.top-0 1440px | p.mt-7.border-t 552px | figcaption.mt-4.border-t 552px | dl.mt-10.grid 544px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Location" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "Availability" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "React / Next.js / TypeScript / Node / Ru" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "React, Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS," 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
